Duration::dim¶

Back to Duration API Reference

Signature¶

std::int64_t Duration::dim() const

What It Tells You¶

dim() returns the logical rank: the number of coordinates required to select one elapsed-time lane. A scalar has rank zero, a vector rank one, a matrix rank two, and a slab collection rank three.

Rank is independent of cardinality. A scalar and a one-element vector both contain one lane but have ranks zero and one. Likewise, shape [2,0,3] retains three axes even though it contains no lanes. Use sizes() for each axis extent and numel() for the total lane count.

Returns¶

The rank as std::int64_t. Public Duration factories accept ranks zero through three and reject higher-rank shapes during construction.

Examples¶

Example 1. Scalar and singleton-vector structure remain distinct.

const auto scalar = pluss::duration::seconds(90);
const auto singleton = pluss::duration::seconds({90});
std::cout << "scalar dim=" << scalar.dim() << " numel=" << scalar.numel() << "\n"
          << "singleton dim=" << singleton.dim() << " numel=" << singleton.numel() << "\n";

Output¶

scalar dim=0 numel=1
singleton dim=1 numel=1

Example 2. Explicit shape controls rank without changing the unit conversion.

const auto matrix = pluss::duration::hours({1,2,3,4}, {2,2});
const auto cube = pluss::duration::nanos({1,2,3,4}, {2,1,2});
std::cout << "matrix dim=" << matrix.dim() << " numel=" << matrix.numel() << "\n"
          << "cube dim=" << cube.dim() << " numel=" << cube.numel() << "\n";

Output¶

matrix dim=2 numel=4
cube dim=3 numel=4

Example 3. A zero extent does not erase its axis.

const auto empty = pluss::duration::zeros({2,0,3});
std::cout << "dim=" << empty.dim() << " numel=" << empty.numel() << "\n";

Output¶

dim=3 numel=0

See Also¶

  • sizes: read every extent.

  • numel: read total cardinality.

  • host: extract lanes in logical row-major order.
